checkpointPayload.description: Fix popup TypeError object is not iterable at new Set in autoJoinTeamOptions/normalizeCustomTeam. Reproduce with server or stored object-form heroIds, normalize supported collection forms consistently and reject malformed values without crashing.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Reproduce the shared helper crash from stack and inspect actual team collection contracts. 2. Normalize object-form hero collections in the classic helper used by Vue and validate IDs; cover options, malformed input and valid array behavior. 3. Run tests/typecheck/build, document root cause, release patch and commit.
